profile.name: Suoming
profile.review:
Suoming is a 5-star Electro Sword Unison Sub-DPS and Main DPS who, as you can tell, can play in 2 very different roles pretty much to the same degree of performance. Suoming is designed in a way where, if you own a Unison Main DPS (so basically Hsin considering her Outro), she can play alongside them as a secondary damage dealer and buffer, and if you don’t, she’s a perfectly viable Basic Attack Main DPS on her own.

Key Mechanics & Rotation Concepts

Let’s clear up something important first: Suoming’s kit is written as though she has multiple states in which separate attacks can be cast, called “Awakened Mind” and “Deep Mind”. In truth, only the Deep Mind state matters because you access it via an Intro, and the Awakened Mind state is only used to enter Deep Mind state. In other words: that state only exists to give Suoming a necessity to cast her Intro to start her rotations. Not much of a need to care about this, since it’s mostly an overly complicated excuse to restrict Quickswap.

Suoming has a Forte gauge that allows her to cast her Forte Skill. This gauge will be built up through her second Intro and Ultimate (in Unison mode only) as well as her Basic Attacks (both DPS and Unison). This Forte Skill then chains into her Drill Skill. Casting this quickly is the focus of her rotation in Unison mode, as by the time you cast it, you’ll have enough Concerto to finish off her full rotation. In DPS mode, Suoming tries to squeeze the most damage out of her Basic Attacks.

Suoming’s Unison is triggered by her Ultimate. If you do Intro —> Ultimate, you can immediately Outro onto another character through the Unison mechanic. If you don’t want this, Suoming’s Unison can be consumed via her base Skill to enter DPS mode. 

  • If you do Suoming’s Unison rotation, Suoming is capable of Unison Response. She grants 1 stack of Unison Boon through her Intro and can benefit from all stacks on her own damage, giving 3% Total DMG Dealt per stack. Additionally, her Outro grants extra Electro DMG Bonus to the next character based on the team’s Unison Boon stack count.

  • Otherwise, if you go down the DPS route, all of the above is forfeited once her Skill is cast. Instead, for 12s, the entirety of Suoming’s Basic Attack damage multipliers are doubled, and her CRIT DMG is increased by 100%. She also consumes 20 Concerto on cast, which is easily built back up throughout her rotation.

Finally, Suoming can cast up to 6 Coordinated Attacks that deal a small amount of damage in Unison only. Her Outro grants 20% Electro DMG Amplification, plus an extra 25% Skill DMG Amplification in Unison, for 8s, with all of this expiring on swap. This is overall completely useless to anything, other than for Hsin with Unison Suoming.

If you want to structure all of the above within a rotation:

In Unison, Suoming will be playing alongside a Unison DPS. She can do Intro —> Ult —> Outro to get off an extremely quick first rotation, then Intro back in once your DPS has acquired Unison, and do a few Basic Attacks into her two Forte Skills, finishing her full rotation.

As a DPS, Suoming will play alongside a traditional Hypercarry Outro buffer and Support. After her Intro and Ultimate, Unison is acquired, allowing for a Skill cast to activate DPS mode. At this point, her most advantageous Basic string in terms of multipliers requires you to hold down the Basic Attack button all throughout (like a Heavy Attack input). You can do up to 2 full strings before your buffs expire, as before they expire Suoming should cast her Forte Skills, at which point her rotation ends and she can switch out.

Meta Position & Conclusion

In the current meta, simply put, Suoming is great. Even if her Unison use is completely restricted to Hsin, and that’s likely to stay the case, in DPS mode she has two things going for her: team flexibility, and teammate accessibility. All of this while retaining pretty solid performance, around early Lahai-Roi level (think Aemeath, Luuk, Sigrika).

What we mean by team flexibility is that Suoming scales off of general buffs. She has no explicit saturation for DMG Amplification, DMG Bonus, or ATK, and scales well off all of them. A F2P teammate particularly stands out for this: Sanhua. Suoming as a DPS is perfectly capable of making full use of her, and revives a previously basically-dead 4-star back into the meta. 

As an added plus, since she doesn’t have CRIT Rate saturation like a lot of the modern damage dealers, she scales well with Shorekeeper. Verina also scales much better for her than most of the recently released DPS cast. Otherwise, the Lynae Mornye duo always works and has higher damage per rotation overall. Being able to make good use of Shorekeeper and Verina is also true in the Unison team.

Although Suoming is practically completely locked out of Quickswap due to her many layers of restrictions around it, for the overwhelming majority of players, Suoming is a great character in ToA/Matrix as DPS while being fairly average in Whimpering Wastes, and she becomes great overall in Unison alongside Hsin, being an undeniable top meta performer in her best team.

In conclusion, Suoming is a pretty well-established character within the Wuthering Waves meta. Either used as a good Main DPS or the ideal Unison Support for Hsin, there are ways to use her for beginners and veterans of the game alike. In all cases, she’s at least going to perform up to endgame standards when used properly. Overall, this makes Suoming a fine character to recommend, so long as you’re interested in getting her on your account.
profile.pros:
• The literal best F2P DPS in the game in ToA/Matrix right now;

  • As a DPS, really easy to make a team with her thanks to Sanhua (one of her best teammates) being free;

  • Has meaningful improvement room in all gamemodes, simply by upgrading to a Unison Hybrid role alongside Hsin, one of the best teams in the game overall;

  • As a Hybrid, can use both 5P Heart and 5P Moonlit Clouds to basically the same degree (at S0R1), so she’s easy to build and not too Signature-reliant there;

  • Fights with a pretty cool umbrella drill thingy.
profile.cons:
• Unison Hybrid use is completely restricted to Hsin, since the overwhelming majority of her buffs are tied to Electro and it’s very, very unlikely we get a second Electro Unison DPS any time soon;

  • Has like 200 layers of restrictions for Quickswap, seriously good luck making her do anything useful there;

  • Sequence value is seriously bad until S6 as a DPS, and as a Hybrid you much rather get Hsin Sequences over Suoming ones. Unless going for S6 DPS specifically, vertically investing isn’t the best idea.

profile.rotations:
Rotation & How to Play

Suoming’s rotation goal is different based on her mode. In Unison teams, she wants to get both of her Outros off as quickly as possible, while as a DPS, she’s trying to make the most of her time on the field while retaining all of her buffs.

Echo Timing

Summon Soulfrayer in the 2nd part of her rotation (Heart of Sworn Vigil/Hybrid) or swap Impermanence Heron right before her 2nd Outro (Moonlit Clouds/Hybrid). As DPS, use Reminiscence: Suhsin at any point after her Skill was cast.

Unison/Hybrid rotation

Used in Hsin/Suoming teams, where Suoming fits a secondary buffer (Hybrid) role and wants to get off her Outro Skills as quickly as she can.

  • Intro

  • Ultimate

  • Outro

→ Build up an Outro from your Unison DPS here.

  • Intro: Whirling (Unison)

  • Basic: Whirling 2 (Cancel animation endlag via Dash)

  • Dash

  • Basic: Unfurled 1

  • Basic: Unfurled 2 (Cancel animation endlag via Skill)

  • Skill: Unforsaken Mind

  • Hold Skill: Engraved Heart

  • Outro

Tip: In case you’re curious about Suoming’s Tap Skill variant, it deals less damage but doesn’t take any less time. The animation that becomes shorter is time-stopped, so overall always hold the Forte Skill. You’re losing out on free damage otherwise.

DPS Rotation

Used for DPS Suoming teams. Forfeits her Unison-related buffs by consuming Unison through her Skill to maximize personal damage.

  • Intro

  • Ultimate

  • Skill (Instantly interrupt via Dash)

  • Dash

  • Heavy: Unfurled Basic 1

  • Heavy: Unfurled Basic 2

  • Heavy: Whirling 1

  • Heavy: Whirling 2 (Cancel animation endlag via Dash)

  • Dash

  • Heavy: Unfurled Basic 1

  • Heavy: Unfurled Basic 2

  • Heavy: Whirling 1

  • Heavy: Whirling 2 (Cancel animation endlag via Skill)

  • Skill: Unforsaken Mind

  • Hold Skill: Engraved Heart

  • Outro

Shortened DPS Rotations

When an enemy is too aggressive and is likely to interrupt you, or if your execution of the above rotation isn’t good enough, it’s very possible for Suoming to lose her 100% CRIT DMG buff or even any active Outro buff on her Hold Skill, which will lose a significant amount of damage. In those cases, you’ll want to shorten her DPS rotation by executing it the same way, but stopping at Heavy: Whirling 1 (the end of its cast). It’s possible to stop even earlier, but keep in mind that the more attacks you can perform while staying within Suoming’s buff windows, the better.

As an indicator, if you want to refer to it Skill: Unforsaken Mind needs to be performed with 16.1s or more left on Suoming’s Ultimate cooldown to preserve the 100% CRIT DMG buff, or 15.3s remaining on the cooldown to preserve 14s Outro buffs.

Additional Tips & Tricks

Optionally, if Suoming’s DPS team rotation is too short (this is possible in Sanhua+Shorekeeper/Verina teams for example), it’s possible to extend the team’s rotation a bit by using Double Intro on Suoming and casting 1 to 3 Basic Attacks after the first Intro. The second Intro would lead to her actual full rotation, as normal.

This is only useful as a rotation extension for extra damage, and doesn’t accomplish much else. Only do this if your team rotation is significantly under 25 seconds (Suoming’s Ultimate cooldown, which she needs to execute her DPS rotations by gaining and consuming Unison). As a Unison Hybrid, you’re better off extending Hsin’s rotation rather than Suoming’s if your rotation time is too low for the same cooldown reasons.

In terms of Quickswap however, Suoming is severely limited. Her rotation can only be meaningfully progressed in Deep Mind state, requiring her to get an Intro from another teammate or at least build up her full Forte gauge once, which takes a very long time. Plus, she needs to be on-field to gain any Forte or cast her Drill Skill, and she loses out on a bunch of self-buffs if she swaps out of her rotation, especially as a DPS. In other words: good luck getting any useful Quickswap done with this character.

Basic Attack

  • Press or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy

  • Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession.

  • Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 2, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder Stage 1 and Stage 2 in succession, dealing Electro DMG.

  • Shortly after casting Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy Stage 4.

    • Shortly after casting the skill, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Bound Obsession, Forged Mind
skills.description:
Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion

  • While in the Awakened Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Furled Canopy: Sealed Delusion, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

    • Casting this skill sends Suoming into Deep Mind and clears all Delusion.

Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind

  • While in the Deep Mind state, when Delusion reaches 800 points, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, pulling in nearby targets and dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart

  • Within a certain period after casting Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Unforsaken Mind, Basic Attack and Resonance Skill are replaced with Basic Attack - Umbral Canopy: Engraved Heart. Press or hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to cast this skill. Attack targets within range, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

    • Casting this skill sends Suoming into Calamity Mind and clears all Delusion; she enters Awakened Mind once the skill ends.

    • When casting this skill, hold Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to continuously attack the target for a certain period.

    • While casting this skill, Suoming is immune to DMG and interruption for a certain period.

    • During the skill action, she cannot move, dash, jump, dodge, or cast Basic Attack, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation, Dodge Counter, Plunging Attack, Mid-air Attack, or Intro Skill, and Resonator switching is also restricted.

Unison

  • When Suoming has Unison, switching to another Resonator will remove her Unison to trigger Suoming's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. When Suoming's Concerto Energy is full and she has Unison, only the Unison effect is consumed.

Unison Response

  • Suoming can trigger Unison Response.

  • When the active Resonator in the team has Unison, Suoming triggers Unison Response after she is switched in and casts Intro Skill, granting all Resonators in the team 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s.

  • Suoming can grant up to 1 stack of Unison Boon. Gaining it again only resets the duration.
    Unison Response cannot be triggered in Co-op.

Unison Boon

  • Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators in the team who can trigger Unison Response by 3%, up to 2 stacks.

Delusion

  • Can hold up to 800 points of Delusion.

    • Hitting a target with Basic Attack, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy, Basic Attack - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder, Dodge Counter, Dodge Counter - Unfurled Canopy, or Resonance Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Crimson Gleam grants Delusion if Suoming is the active Resonator.

    • Casting Resonance Liberation grants 200 points of Delusion.

    • Casting Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Thunder Rending or Intro Skill - Unfurled Canopy: Whirling Thunder (Unison) grants 200 points of Delusion.

weapons.Comment: Suoming's Signature and best weapon, with the unique ability to have different effects based on your use case: As a DPS, it gives her a massive 70% Electro DMG Bonus boost, meanwhile as a Unison Hybrid she gives 24% Electro DMG Bonus to the team and an extra 30% to herself. Pair that with good CRIT Rate and ATK stats for some nice value as a Hybrid and the best damage you can get as a DPS.

Camellya's Signature can allow you to completely skip Suoming's Signature as a DPS, since both of them provide pure damage buffs and while Red Spring is a bit worse than Unspoken Rue, they give almost the exact same stats to Suoming thanks to her ability to consume Concerto as a DPS. Has lower value in Unison teams since Suoming won't consume Concerto to fully activate this weapon's passive, and it won't buff the team either.

Best permanent banner option, providing Suoming with some Energy Regen and some ATK when casting Skill, as well as solid Base ATK and CRIT Rate.
Best 4-star option in Unison, this sword provides some solid ATK, Liberation DMG and CRIT Rate boosts, though its low Base ATK makes it worse than any 5-star.

While Suoming can fully utilize this Sword's passive as a DPS, making it her best 4-star in that mode, she has a hard time making good use of it in Unison, and also it does not give any CRIT stats, so it pales in comparison to the above options.

Best no-gacha option, offering nothing but ATK stats. Serves as a decent replacement to 5-star choices until one can replace it. Strongly recommended to go for Signature as a DPS if this is your best option, otherwise you can settle for this until a 5-star is acquired in Unison.

echoes.Comment: Hsin's Signature set also works totally fine on Suoming. It's her best set as a DPS by far and provides the same performance as Moonlit Clouds at S0R1 investment (while being better at higher investment) in the Unison team. Generally always recommended at S0R1+.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: Best for Unison Suoming. Provides 12% Electro DMG Bonus to the next character coming in via Outro for 15s on cast, making it the best to buff Hsin in your Unison team.
echoes.Echo_2_Comment: Best for DPS Suoming. Simple Summon Echo, gives Suoming 20% Electro DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot, making it her best as a DPS for that reason alone.

echoes.Comment: Best set for Unison Suoming at lower investments. On alternative weapons or bad Echo builds at S0R1, this set's higher buffing potential can outdo the higher personal damage Heart of Sworn Vigil provides, making it situationally better than - and always a good replacement to - the set.
echoes.Echo_1_Comment: The best option 5P Moonlit Clouds has in most cases. Transform Echo that grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give.

teams.Comments: For the best results, only use Lynae and Mornye together. Prioritize Sanhua+Shorekeeper/Verina compositions otherwise.

synergies.Comment: Suoming's best and only good Unison partner is Hsin. Almost all of Suoming's bufs are related to Unison, Electro characters, of which Hsin is liikely to be the only one for a while. As a result, when together, they can form one of the best teams in the game.

Suoming isn't only limited to being a Hsin Unison secondary, she's also a very capable Main DPS. Alongside Lynae (with Mornye) or Sanhua (with Shorekeeper/Verina), she makes for one of the better and most F2P-friendly damage dealers in the game.

Best Support options for Suoming, who doesn't scale off any particular Support's specializations currently. Shorekeeper is the best overall, Verina is her F2P replacement. Mornye is only used alongside Lynae in a DPS Suoming team.
